title: The Marvel Role Rachel McAdams Said No To
summary:
Gwyneth Paltrow played Pepper Potts, the assistant and later wife of Tony Stark, in the Marvel movies. She played Pepper from the first Marvel movie, "Iron Man" in 2008, to "Avengers: Endgame" in 2019. But Paltrow was not the first person Marvel asked to play the role.

In December 2006, Marvel sent the "Iron Man" script only to Rachel McAdams. They hoped she would play Pepper. McAdams was becoming a big star.

McAdams took a break from acting from 2006 to 2008. She was in only two movies in that time. The break did not hurt her career. She later earned an Oscar nomination for "Spotlight." The first big movie she said yes to after her break was "Sherlock Holmes" in 2009, with Robert Downey Jr., who had just become a huge star as Iron Man.

Marvel did not forget her. McAdams later joined Marvel as Dr. Christine Palmer in "Doctor Strange." She came back for the next movie, "Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness."
why_it_matters: It shows that saying no to a big chance can still lead to a good career, and that taking a break is sometimes the right choice.
